rows.comment: energy and emotional generosity of a 1940s Hollywood melodrama.
rows.verdict_le10: energy and emotional generosity of a 1940s Hollywood melodrama.
rows.dek_lead: Despite its elegiac tone and stark social realism, its loose three-act structure and leisurely narrative flow, “Ash Is Purest White” has some of the grit, energy and emotional generosity of a 1940s Hollywood melodrama.
